changes.prompt: integrations/openclaw/persona_ooda_runtime.py::build_brokered_cycle_prompt now instructs the persona to call persona_memory_recall on its own bank (bank="own") at least once before its first persona_proposal_submit, while keeping bank="facts" and persona_mental_model_read optional as often as judged useful.
changes.broker: services/openclaw-gateway-adapter/persona_tool_broker.py::PersonaToolBroker._proposal enforces that for purpose == 'daily_cycle', a proposal is refused with HTTP 409 and reason 'recall_required_before_proposal' (message telling the model to call persona_memory_recall with bank="own" at least once before persona_proposal_submit) until the run has recorded an own-bank persona_memory_recall for that persona. A zero-hit own-bank recall (outcome='ok', count=0) satisfies the rule. An own-bank recall that failed with MemoryCallError (recorded as outcome='unavailable' with bank='own') allows subsequent proposals in the same run so a memory outage never blocks all proposals, noting the failure in result['recall_failure'] and the proposal call's reason ('recall_unavailable:<reason>'). Facts-bank recalls, standing-question reads, and other personas' recalls never satisfy the own-bank requirement. Panel interpretation runs and other run purposes keep their existing behaviour.
